name: Mrs. Kerr
excerpt: Mrs. Kerr is a perky blond woman who replaces Mrs. Dodds as the pre-algebra teacher.
notes: Mrs. Kerr is introduced as the pre-algebra teacher at Yancy Academy after Mrs. Dodds disappears. The students and staff act as if she has been the teacher since Christmas, despite Percy never having seen her before.
context_summary:
- Mrs. Kerr is a blond woman.
- She replaces Mrs. Dodds as the pre-algebra teacher.
- She is introduced after Mrs. Dodds disappears.
- Students act as if she has been the teacher since Christmas.
